policy.selection: Public, freely downloadable reports from government agencies and open research repositories. No personal, employment, customer or contract documents. No documents from the energy sector.
policy.redistribution: Source files are not redistributed in this repository. The fetch script downloads each file from its publisher and verifies the recorded SHA-256 before anything is imported. The retained results and live transcripts quote the passages the corpus tools returned; each document's rights entry below is the basis on which those excerpts are kept.
policy.attribution: United States federal works (Federal Reserve Board, NIST, NASA) are in the public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105. California Department of Education reports are public records of a California state agency. The two arXiv papers are published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence; their attribution entries record title, authors, source and licence, and note that the excerpts were produced by converting the PDF with Docling. Nothing here claims endorsement by any publisher or author.
